title: The AI trade gets a boost ahead of earnings seasons' final boss
excerpt: The AI infrastructure trade is back.
content_html:
By William Edwards

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

The AI infrastructure trade is back.

It was just a few weeks ago that investors started dumping the stocks left and right amid fears that hyperscalers were going to stop spending on the new technology. The PHLX Semiconductor Sector (SOX) had dropped 29% from June 22 to July 29.

But a few earnings reports on Tuesday are helping to inject some life back into the trade. Here were a couple of highlights:

  • CoreWeave, a data center firm, saw year-over-year revenue growth of 112% in Q2, and a huge backlog of orders for its compute power. Its stock rose more than 19% on Wednesday.
  • Nebius saw 450% revenue growth year-over-year as companies buy up its AI cloud storage. Its stock surged 32% on Wednesday.

So much for that impending spending dry spell that investors were sweating over.

On Wednesday morning, I spoke with Brad Neuman, the director of market strategy at asset management firm Alger, which invests in Nebius, Nvidia, and other AI infrastructure stocks. He said his firm continues to see the AI buildout as one of the biggest opportunities in the market.

"I think we're more worried about supply than demand," he said. "In other words, the ability to bring on data centers, build them, connect them to the grid, etc., rather than demand, which is, I think, growing very fast for user-end tokens."

The upbeat earnings reports come as hyperscalers like Microsoft and Amazon have started to show that they can monetize their investments in the AI buildout. Both reported robust growth in their cloud businesses in their Q2 earnings calls at the end of July. That realization of monetization prompted JPMorgan this week to up its 2026 S&P 500 price target to 8,000.

All of this provides a nice setup for the AI trade heading into Nvidia earnings, which will come on August 26. Nvidia's stock has struggled over the last few months, down 4.9% since mid-May.

If key Nvidia partners like CoreWeave and Nebius are seeing demand surge, and hyperscalers are starting to see returns on their AI spending, then Nvidia could be positioned for a strong quarter.

Nvidia is the largest company on the planet with a $5.4 trillion market cap and a bellwether for the broader AI trade.

And when Nvidia does well, the broader market tends to follow suit.

作者：William Edwards 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

人工智能基础设施贸易又回来了。

就在几周前，由于担心超大规模企业将停止在新技术上的支出，投资者开始左右抛售股票。 从 6 月 22 日到 7 月 29 日，PHLX 半导体板块 (SOX) 下跌了 29%。

但周二发布的几份收益报告正在帮助该行业重新注入活力。 以下是一些亮点：

  • 数据中心公司 CoreWeave 第二季度收入同比增长 112%，其计算能力积压了大量订单。 周三其股价上涨超过 19%。
  • 随着企业收购 Nebius 的 AI 云存储，其收入同比增长 450%。 其股价周三飙升 32%。

即将到来的支出枯竭期就到此为止，投资者们都为之捏了一把汗。

周三上午，我与资产管理公司 Alger 的市场策略总监 Brad Neuman 进行了交谈，该公司投资 Nebius、Nvidia 和其他人工智能基础设施股票。 他表示，他的公司仍然将人工智能建设视为市场上最大的机会之一。

“我认为我们更担心供应而不是需求，”他说。 “换句话来说，是建立数据中心、构建数据中心、将其连接到电网等的能力，而不是需求，我认为这对于用户端代币来说增长非常快。”

乐观的收益报告发布之际，微软和亚马逊等超大规模企业已开始表明他们可以将人工智能建设的投资货币化。 两家公司在 7 月底的第二季度财报电话会议上都报告了云业务的强劲增长。 货币化的实现促使摩根大通本周将 2026 年标准普尔 500 指数目标价格提高至 8,000 点。

所有这些都为 Nvidia 将于 8 月 26 日公布财报的人工智能交易奠定了良好的基础。 过去几个月，英伟达的股价一直表现不佳，自 5 月中旬以来已下跌 4.9%。

如果 CoreWeave 和 Nebius 等 Nvidia 的主要合作伙伴看到需求激增，并且超大规模企业开始看到其人工智能支出的回报，那么 Nvidia 可能会迎来一个强劲的季度。

Nvidia 是全球最大的公司，市值达 5.4 万亿美元，是更广泛的人工智能行业的领头羊。

当英伟达表现出色时，更广泛的市场往往会效仿。
